description: Stereo compressor with CV over every control, peak or RMS detection, upward compression and mid-side working.

params.text: Sets the level the detector acts on, -50dB to 0dB; the default is -30dB.
Scales the CV for the control it serves, -100% to 100%; negative settings invert the CV.
Sets how fast the gain reacts to a signal crossing the threshold, 0.02ms to 100ms.
Sets how fast the gain recovers once the signal falls back, 40ms to 5 seconds.
Bends the attack from exponential through linear to logarithmic, -1 to +1.
Bends the release from exponential through linear to logarithmic, -1 to +1; old opto compressors released exponentially.
Sets how hard the gain is pulled back past the threshold, 1:1 to 20:1.
Softens the corner at the threshold, 0dB to 10dB wide.
Lifts the compressed signal back up, 0dB to 30dB; in upward mode the same amount is taken off instead.
Blends the dry input with the compressed signal, 0 to 100% compressed; the default is 100%.
Passes the inputs straight to the outputs with no compression and no makeup gain.
Switches the detector between instantaneous peak reading and an averaged RMS reading.
Sets the length of the averaging window used in RMS detection, 0.02ms to 50ms.
Puts a 4000Hz low pass filter in front of the detector, so transients pass before the gain moves.
Puts a 240Hz high pass filter in front of the detector, so low frequencies do not drive the gain.
Encodes the two inputs as mid and side, compresses there, and decodes back to left and right.
Compresses the mid part while mid-side mode is on; with this off the mid passes at its own level.
Compresses the side part while mid-side mode is on; with this off the side passes at its own level.
Lifts the level going into the detector, 0dB to 30dB, without changing the signal that passes through.
Switches between pulling back signals above the threshold and lifting signals below it.

inputs.text: Adds to the threshold, 3dB per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the attack time, and to the attack curve as well when that curve's attenuverter is turned up.
Adds to the release time, and to the release curve as well when that curve's attenuverter is turned up.
Adds to the compression ratio, 10V covering the full range before the attenuverter.
Adds to the width of the soft corner, 1dB per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the makeup gain, 3dB per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the wet/dry blend, 10V covering the full range before the attenuverter.
A trigger here flips the switch it serves; a menu option turns these into gate inputs instead.
Adds to the length of the RMS averaging window before the attenuverter.
The left signal to be compressed; with nothing patched to the right input, this one feeds both channels.
The right signal to be compressed; leaving this unpatched sends the left input to both channels.
Feeds the detector from this signal instead of the inputs, so another sound drives the gain.
Adds to the input gain, 3dB per volt before the attenuverter.

outputs.text: That channel of the compressed signal, blended with the dry input by MIX.
The gain reduction as a voltage, rising as more reduction is applied.

menu: Envelope Mode — how the envelope output is scaled, one of Linear - Gain Reduced, Linear or Exponential; the last two put out very high voltages at large gain reductions.
CV Gate Mode — reads the CV inputs of the switches as gates rather than as triggers.
